events.text: The Aztecs have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Founders' Legacy (+2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from [ICON_BUILDING_MONUMENT] Monuments and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from [ICON_BUILDING_GRANARY] Granaries)
The Inca have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Goddess of the Hunt (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food from Camps)

America has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Patron of Weavers (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each [ICON_RES_SILK] Silk, Dye, and [ICON_RES_COTTON] Cotton resource)

Korea has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)
Uncle Yasya completes Temple of Artemis!

Polynesia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)
The Shoshone have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Warband Forge (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from [ICON_BUILDING_BARRACKS] Barracks)
JAGUARRR has made peace with goldar!
Uncle Yasya completes Mausoleum of Halicarnassus!

The Aztecs have founded the new religion Zoroastrianism in the holy city of Tenochtitlan:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Tithe[ENDCOLOR] +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every 4 followers of this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Hawk Spirit[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_AQUEDUCT] Aqueducts provide +5 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food.
JAGUARRR completes Great Mosque of Djenne!
A golden age begins for the Polynesian civilization.

The Shoshone have founded the new religion Eastern Orthodoxy in the holy city of Moson Kahni:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Daily Bread[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +6 [ICON_FOOD] Food[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pagodas[ENDCOLOR] Allows you to build Pagodas with [ICON_PEACE] Faith (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith, +4 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness)[NEWLINE][ICON_PEACE] Faith cost on Quick speed: Pagoda 150.

America has founded the new religion Confucianism in the holy city of Washington:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Golden Altar[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +10 [ICON_GOLD] Gold[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Religious Center[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_TEMPLE] Temples provide +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness, +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. [ICON_BUILDING_GRAND_TEMPLE] Grand Temple provides +5 [ICON_GOLD] Gold

Korea has founded the new religion Islam in the holy city of Seoul:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Peace Loving[ENDCOLOR] +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Global Happiness for every 12 followers of this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Religious Community[ENDCOLOR] +1% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for each follower (max +10%). [ICON_BUILDING_GRAND_TEMPLE] Grand Temple provides +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production
Art has proven that the world is round!
A golden age begins for the American civilization.

Polynesia has founded the new religion Catholicism in the holy city of Honolulu:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Coffers of the Faithful[ENDCOLOR] +1% [ICON_GOLD] Gold in a city for every follower of this religion there, up to a maximum of +15%[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Star Navigation[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_LIGHTHOUSE] Lighthouses provide +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_RESEARCH] Science and +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness.
